name: GLVC Cross Country Championships
headline: GLVC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Lewis swept the titles, the men with 30 points over Missouri S&T (48) and the women with 53 over Southwest Baptist (63). Lewis’ Evan Horgan won the men’s race in 23:07.4 and Rockhurst’s Carrington Hessen the women’s in 20:01.9.
